public class PlotGrid extends DrawableObject
A drawable object that renders a simple coordinate grid consisting of horizontal and vertical axes centered in the panel, along with a label at the origin point (0,0).

This class provides a minimal, default grid suitable for basic plotting scenarios. It is intended for simple use cases such as demonstrations, prototypes, or educational examples. For more advanced grid features (e.g., tick marks, scaling, multiple axes, or labeled units), a custom implementation should be used.

  • Methodendetails

    • setGridPosition

      public void setGridPosition(GridPosition gridPosition, JPanel frame)
      Sets the position of the coordinate grid relative to the drawing panel by adjusting the global offset values (PlotApplication.X_DELTA and PlotApplication.Y_DELTA). The grid is positioned based on one of the predefined GridPosition constants, taking into account the panel dimensions and a fixed padding to avoid clipping at the edges.
      Parameter:
      gridPosition - the desired alignment of the grid (e.g., CENTER, NORTH_EAST, etc.)
      frame - the drawing panel used to determine available width and height

    • setZoomX

      public void setZoomX(double amount)
      Sets the horizontal zoom scale factor for the entire application. The input value is normalized to ensure it remains within a reasonable range.
      Parameter:
      amount - the desired zoom factor (e.g., 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = 2x zoom in)

    • setZoomY

      public void setZoomY(double amount)
      Sets the vertical zoom scale factor for the entire application. The input value is normalized to ensure it remains within a reasonable range.
      Parameter:
      amount - the desired zoom factor (e.g., 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = 2x zoom in)

    • configureGraphics

      public void configureGraphics(Graphics g)
      Configures basic rendering using the Graphics context. This implementation does nothing, as all drawing is handled in the Graphics2D method.
      Parameter:
      g - the basic graphics context

    • configureGraphics2D

      public void configureGraphics2D(Graphics2D g)
      Renders the coordinate axes and origin label using the Graphics2D context. Draws a horizontal and vertical gray line through the center of the panel to represent the x and y axes, and labels the origin with "0" in dark gray.
      Parameter:
      g - the enhanced 2D graphics context
